## Keep or rush

In seminar order. Planned total about 55 minutes.

| Item | Min | | If short |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Problem 1: ... | 0 | Keep | The one thing to say |
| Problem 2: ... | 0 | Rush; cut first | The one-line fallback |
| Coding 1: ... | 0 | Rush | |

Minimum seminar, about N minutes: the items to protect. With more time, add ... back first.

## If you read on

How it runs

- Three lines at most: what students did before, the link to the complete notebook, what is outside the seminar.

What students should see

- The numbers.

Where they get stuck

- Five bullets at most.
